mapper.select: SELECT * FROM( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, ACC_QUA_FLAG AS accQuaFlag, GEN_DETSUB_FLAG AS genDetsubFlag, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AS baseSubjectNature, FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 CONNECT BY FSUBJECT_ID = PRIOR SUBJECT_NO AND BOOKSET_ID = PRIOR BOOKSET_ID ) TMP WHERE TMP.subjectNo = #{subjectNo}
SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO as id, SUBJECT_NAME as text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 CONNECT BY FSUBJECT_ID = PRIOR SUBJECT_NO

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{level3}
AND (SUBJECT_NO LIKE concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR SUBJECT_NAME LIKE concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
